column2: Every internal link in the portfolio that returns 404, one row per broken URL. Issue IDs match the Vercel Build Issues tab, which is why that tab skips these numbers. Column D is the destination to send the URL to and column E is that destination status-checked live: 200 means the page already exists and this is a one-line redirect, 404 means the destination has to be built first. Column H lists every page containing the bad link, and column I the anchor text used on each, so in-body links can be edited directly. Only Dallas and Fort Worth have broken internal links; the other 10 builds came back clean. Facility
